orchestration_incidents.trigger: the committed stop switch was used to prevent a stale 29-configuration supervisor from entering downstream aggregation before the 66-configuration controller could resume

attempt.signal: none; normal exit after observing stop switch

orchestration_incidents.scientific_consequence: none: atomic writers landed no result and all sixteen identities remain missing and retryable
orchestration_incidents.repair: restart the committed 66-configuration supervisor in a persistent PTY and do not close that PTY while any descendants are active

orchestration_incidents.trigger: launch_environment refuses any shard launch while git reports src or fastforge dirty. The Substrate master program was writing new modules under src/mop/cognition in the same worktree, so codelife could not launch and the supervisor returned from its required startup stage

observation.supervisor_exit: clean return, so launchd KeepAlive SuccessfulExit false did not restart it

orchestration_incidents.scientific_consequence: none. The eight principal speech_stream shards run in their own process groups under start_new_session and were untouched. No stage had work to launch while the supervisor was down, so no shard was delayed and no receipt was written or lost
orchestration_incidents.repair: the Substrate files were committed, src returned clean, and the supervisor was restarted with launchctl kickstart without the kill flag. It re adopted all eight live workers through the lock scan and relaunched none of them, which is the behaviour the lock reservation was built for
orchestration_incidents.running_wave_policy: do not interrupt the active wave. A concurrent program editing src in this worktree must land its edits in commits before the supervisor next needs to launch anything

orchestration_incidents.trigger: old supervisor could not see append-only convergence indices 11 through 28
orchestration_incidents.scientific_consequence: none: atomic writers landed no result and all six identities remain missing
orchestration_incidents.repair: resume all identities from committed authority 05af7a9; future handoffs must preserve the terminal process group
